line: That’s if you want to, I’m just playin’, girl, stop smackin’ your teeth
vault_lines: That's if you want to, I'm just playin', girl, stop smackin' your teeth (21, 21)
meaning: Of course he’s joking about the previous line. Unless he’s not. The narrator plants the seed of an idea, and then retracts it just enough to make it an intriguing possibility.

line: I come through from time to time and have you grabbin’ them sheets (21)
vault_lines: I come through from time to time and have you grabbin' them sheets (21)
meaning: Here the narrator is hinting in a not-so-subtle way that despite their failed relationship, and despite the fact that she will one day be in a new relationship, possibly even married, he will always be on standby to bring her to heights of sexual pleasure. The implication in “come through from time to time” being that she will be less-than-completely-satisfied in her future relationship and in need of sexual rescue. It is Usher, after all.

line: I hate that we didn’t make it to forever Probably ain’t gettin’ back together But that don’t mean that I can’t wish you better (Oh-oh) We ain’t good good, but we still good
vault_lines: We ain't good good, but we still good
meaning: This is basically saying clearly that just because they broke up or aren’t together anymore doesn’t mean they cant still be close or on good terms. <3

vault_lines: We enjoy the five-star meals, but you was with me for the Zaxby’s (Facts)
meaning: “Zaspi” should be “Zaxby’s” as in the fast food restaurant. This line is basically saying that even though the ex was with 21 Savage while he was rich, should would have also been with him if he didn’t have as much.
